items.t: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN) Reports Early MASLD Trial Data With 62% Liver Fat Normalization
items.sum: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (NasdaqGS:REGN) reported first in human data for CIDEBsiRNA, a liver targeted siRNA candidate for MASLD. The early study showed sustained normalization of liver fat and improvement in liver injury markers in treated participants. Results were presented at a major medical meeting and published in a top tier journal, extending Regeneron's RNAi ambitions into liver disease.

items.t: Amgen vs. Regeneron: Higher Dividends Now or Bigger Growth Later?
